name: Campotéjar (Spain)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Campotéjar (pomegranates on blue with crown, mantling and flags, with the motto DEO REGNARE SERVIRE EST).
history: Municipal flag of Campotéjar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
